Context: B. Court Attachment

## B. Court Attachment  
1. An Officer was drawing the Pay in the Pay Matrix at the Level 7 of ~ 60,400 from 1-7-2023. A Court attachment order for the first time in his service for the recovery of ~ 4,86,650 from his salary was received in August, 2023. The attachment order is not for maintenance. Calculate the amount recoverable each month and the total amount that can be recovered [ DA 42%, HRA 18% ].
